tools.name: get_current_weather
tools.rich: Conditions right now at one location: temperature, humidity, wind, precipitation. Not a forecast; for future days use the daily forecast tool.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: units
params.rich: metric (Celsius, km/h) or imperial (Fahrenheit, mph). Defaults to metric.

tools.name: get_forecast
tools.rich: Daily forecast for the next 1 to 10 days at one location: high, low, precipitation chance. For hour-by-hour detail use the hourly forecast tool.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: days
params.rich: Number of days ahead, 1 to 10.

params.name: units
params.rich: metric (Celsius, km/h) or imperial (Fahrenheit, mph). Defaults to metric.

tools.name: get_hourly_forecast
tools.rich: Hour-by-hour forecast for the next 1 to 48 hours at one location. For whole days use the daily forecast tool.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: hours
params.rich: Number of hours ahead, 1 to 48.

tools.name: get_air_quality
tools.rich: Current air-quality index and the dominant pollutant at one location.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

tools.name: get_uv_index
tools.rich: Peak UV index for one location on one date.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_pollen_count
tools.rich: Tree, grass and weed pollen levels for one location on one date.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_severe_alerts
tools.rich: Active severe-weather warnings issued for a region, such as a state or province.

params.name: region
params.rich: State, province or country, e.g. 'Florida'.

tools.name: get_historical_weather
tools.rich: Observed weather at one location on a past date. Not for future dates.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: date
params.rich: A past date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_sunrise_sunset
tools.rich: Sunrise, sunset and day length at one location on one date.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: date
params.rich: The date, YYYY-MM-DD.

tools.name: get_marine_forecast
tools.rich: Wave height, swell and wind for a coastal station over the next 1 to 5 days.

params.name: station
params.rich: Coastal station name, e.g. 'Cascais'.

params.name: days
params.rich: Days ahead, 1 to 5.

tools.name: get_climate_normals
tools.rich: Thirty-year typical temperature and rainfall for one location in one month. Not a forecast.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: month
params.rich: Month name in English, e.g. 'March'.

tools.name: get_weather_radar
tools.rich: A link to the latest precipitation radar image around one location.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

tools.name: get_average_temperature
tools.rich: One mean temperature over the next 1 to 10 days at one location. Not the daily highs and lows; for those use the daily forecast tool.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: days
params.rich: Number of days ahead, 1 to 10.

params.name: units
params.rich: metric (Celsius, km/h) or imperial (Fahrenheit, mph). Defaults to metric.

tools.name: get_humidity_forecast
tools.rich: Relative humidity, as a percentage, for each of the next 1 to 10 days at one location. For the reading right now use the current conditions tool.

params.name: location
params.rich: City name; add the country when the city name alone could be ambiguous.

params.name: days
params.rich: Number of days ahead, 1 to 10.
